'''Brogan Ley''' was an ambitious [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani]] who was a high-ranking executive in [[Tampson Consolidated, Incorporated|TamCo]] by the time he was only thirty-two years of age.<ref name="LOTE" />

Ley was educated at the [[Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy]]. He was charismatic, opportunistic, intelligent and a gifted public speaker. In business, he was ruthless and obsessed with the bottom line. He was very manipulative and cared nothing for the people he had to step on to achieve his business and personal goals. He was intent on gaining legitimacy in the eyes of [[House Mecetti]] nobles and planned to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] a noblewoman to achieve this goal.<ref name="LOTE" />
